Sandbox_Sandevistan_Preset_tooltip: Picks a ready-made set of Sandevistan rules. Anything other than Custom OVERRIDES the individual options below (the menu fills them in for you); Custom uses the options exactly as you set them.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Preset_option2: Arcade (all the power, almost no punishment)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CharacterTraits_tool: Off = the mod's 8 traits (You Are Special, Edgerunner, Ex-Corpo, Chrome Rejection...) don't show up when creating a character. Characters that already have one keep it and it still works.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ALifeImplants: Project A-Life NPCs with an implant
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ALifeImplants_toolti: Only with Project A-Life [ALIFE NPCS]. An NPC dressed with the Sandevistan spine in the A-Life creator leaves the implant in its corpse, and you extract it like an ex-subject's: military-grade comes out pristine, a lab prototype slightly worn. Off = the spine on those NPCs is only a look.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_HeatRateMultiplier_t: How fast the Heat rises while the implant is on. Higher = shorter runs before a thermal cutout.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_AmbientCooling_toolt: Only a bonus: cold weather, a wet body and wind outdoors cool the implant faster. It never makes cooling worse.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_StaminaDebt_tooltip: While the Sandevistan runs your stamina does not drop: everything you spend (running, sprinting, hitting, pushing and the implant's own drain) becomes debt and is charged all at once when it goes off. Natural regeneration pays the debt instead of raising the bar. Normal also staggers you and blocks sprinting if the debt went past what you had; Gentle only charges it.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_StaminaDebt_option2: Normal (debt is charged with the overdraft price)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_StaminaDebt_option3: Gentle (debt is charged, no stagger or sprint block)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_BookGuide_tooltip: Without the skill level, the vanilla books of that skill in your inventory let you do it anyway: slower and with a chance to fail. You need the books of the levels you are missing (with First Aid 0 for something that needs 4, volumes 1 and 2; with 2, only volume 2), and the penalty is smaller the closer you are to the level. At the required level there is no penalty at all.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_BookGuide_option2: Gentle (less time and lower fail chance)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_BookGuide_option4: Harsh (much more time and higher fail chance)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ImmunoDurationMultip: Scales how many hours each dose covers you (clinical, homemade and herbal).
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Immunodepression_too: Each dose lowers your defenses for a while: wounds get infected more and heal slower, and colds and sickness hit harder. Light and Harsh scale those effects.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PartsLootMultiplier_: Scales how often neural boards, thermal regulators and power cells appear as loot. 0 = never (craft them).
Sandbox_Sandevistan_UseSpatialSlowInSP_t: Use strategy B (nearby zombies slowed) in singleplayer too. Off = experimental global clock.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CatastrophicFailureC: Without cyberpsychosis. Overdrive never destroys the implant. Default 0.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CyberpsychosisDeathC: Default 0.01. Cyberpsychosis also adds a 20%% chance of a deep chest cut.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Hallucinations_toolt: Local hallucinations with cyberpsychosis and neural load 60+.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CraftedRecipeKnown_t: Everyone knows the recipe without reading the notebook.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CivilExSubjectChance: Every campus always has one ex-subject next to the notes and the implant. One roll per campus at world creation decides whether there is a second one.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ExSubjectRespawn_too: Spawns extra ex-subjects with low chance in case the fixed ones despawn.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ExSubjectRespawnChan: Chance per check (every 24 h per zone)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Prototype06Enabled_t: Allows studying a loose implant and building replicas that perform like Prototype 05.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisIntensity_t: One knob for every cyberpsychosis symptom. It applies on top of the difficulty and the individual options below: it never turns on something they turned off. Neural Load and its costs do not change; only how much you notice it.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisIntensity_o: Mild (half as often, no blackouts, misfires, jump scares or disguise)
Brutal (more often, more fake zombies and twice the jump scares)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisAudio_toolt: Fake footsteps, groans, bangs, glass and whispers that only the player hears (they do not attract zombies).
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisThreatVisio: Faint red brackets on nearby zombies you cannot see (behind walls or corners), same floor only. Your reflexes sense them. With your head a mess, now and then a marker shows up on someone who is not there, mostly behind you, and dissolves as soon as you look that way.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisTimeGlitch_: With cyberpsychosis the dilation stutters: nearby zombies briefly return to normal speed.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisMisfire_too: At critical neural load the implant can fire by itself for a few seconds when a zombie attacks you.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisBlackouts_t: At critical neural load: tunnel vision, heartbeat and sometimes a moment of darkness (you can still move).
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisBerserk_too: With cyberpsychosis and the implant on: more melee damage and attack speed, no panic, less pain.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisNightTerror: With high neural load you may wake up screaming after a few hours of sleep.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisFakeZombies: Zombies that don't exist chase you and dissolve when they touch you or you hit them. Needs the SandevistanPsychosis mod and the Hallucinations option.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisEchoes_tool: Zombies you can see leave red and cyan afterimages, like double vision. Needs the SandevistanViewpoint afterimage mod and the Hallucinations option.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisTextGlitch_: Now and then the letters on screen turn into symbols. Needs the SandevistanPsychosis mod and the Hallucinations option.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisMessages_to: Now and then, inside a text that is already being corrupted, a short coherent phrase appears for a moment. It can land on a label, a tooltip or chat. Needs the SandevistanPsychosis mod and the Hallucinations option.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisPhantomFigu: A dark, see-through figure shows at the edge of your view and dissolves if you look straight at it or get close. Needs the SandevistanPsychosis mod and the Hallucinations option.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisDisguise_to: At stage 3, very rarely and for 20 to 40 s, you see others with the other side's skin. Only you see it. Zombies seen as people are real and really bite; the tell is that now and then they "skip" back to what they are. Needs the SandevistanPsychosis mod and the Hallucinations option.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisDisguise_op: Players seen as zombies too, only with PvP off
Players seen as zombies too, always (even with PvP)
Sandbox_Sandevistan_PsychosisOverload_to: When neural load hits 100: forced shutdown, knockout, nosebleed and a scream that attracts zombies (load drops to 85). With cyberpsychosis, sometimes a locked 15-second total fury instead.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_OverdriveHeatCap_too: Repeated Overdrive collapses lower your maximum Heat: the first collapse each in-game day is free, each extra one costs 5 (total fury 15, down to 50). It recovers 1 per hour while the implant is off. Thermal and manual cutoffs never lower it.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_CyberpsychosisRemiss: Cyberpsychosis fades after 5 in-game days without any implant installed (you have to remove it). It leaves a scar: neural load from use rises 25%% faster afterwards. Off = permanent.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_SlowZombieAnimations: Zombies slowed by the Sandevistan also play their walk, run, lunge, turn and attack animations in slow motion (extra animation nodes, vanilla files untouched). Off = only their movement is slowed.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FastPlayerAnimations: While the Sandevistan is on, your walk, run and sprint animations play faster in step with the speed boost (extra animation nodes, vanilla files untouched). Off = only your position is boosted and the legs may slide.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_MPHitRateGuard_toolt: Multiplayer only. The server kicks players who hit more than 3 zombies in 1.2 seconds with a normal weapon (AntiCheatHit=2, the default). With this on, Sandevistan attacks drop to normal speed right before that limit. Turn it off only if the server has AntiCheatHit=3 (log only) or 4 (disabled). Admins are never limited.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_SlowRadius_tooltip: How far from you zombies (and other players in multiplayer) are slowed while the Sandevistan is on. Larger = the slowdown starts farther away and the transition is less visible, but more zombies are processed.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FieldGuideOnInstall: Give the field guide on first implant
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FieldGuideOnInstall_: A field guide item (Heat, Neural Load, rejection, adaptation, surgery and extraction, crafting and blueprints) is added to the pack of whoever receives their first implant. Existing implanted characters get it once.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FirearmActionSpeed_t: While the Sandevistan is on, reloading, racking the bolt and loading or ejecting magazines run as much faster as your own speed boost. Damage and aim are untouched.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Prototype07Enabled_t: Allows researching a working military implant (with both military dossiers complete) and building a replica from special parts. Off = the military variant can only be found.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FirmwareEnabled_tool: Turns on firmware chips: two slots (System and Skill) that change how the implant behaves. Off, chips do nothing and cannot be installed.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FirmwareAllKnown: Know every firmware program from the start
Sandbox_Sandevistan_FirmwareAllKnown_too: If on, every program is known from the start. Otherwise they are learned as the adaptation level grows.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_ImplantOverride_tool: With the implant off, holding the key skips the air or heat safety and goes straight into Overdrive. It always ends in a collapse and you pay for it: no air means fatigue and no sprinting until you recover; stuck from heat means a burn, wear and a thermal scar.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Stopgaps_tooltip: The game's painkillers, sleeping pills and beta blockers slow rejection and neural load a little, for a while and with tolerance. They do not replace immunosuppressants: they only buy time.
Sandbox_Sandevistan_Craving_tooltip: With high neural load and 12 h without using the implant, stress and unhappiness slowly climb and the monitor insists; it fades on its own at 48 h. Using it for 10 s resets it. It never touches neural load.
